title: Potatoism Integration Contract
purpose: Canonical routing contract for making the Potatoism corpus searchable, navigable and graph-visible.
required_invariants: Every Potatoism entity must have a stable id.
Every relationship endpoint must resolve to a node or declared external reference.
Every public observation must preserve source, URL, type and confidence.
Mythological, interpretive, empirical and disputed claims must remain distinguishable.
Search must include aliases and definitions, not only titles.
Node pages must expose inbound and outbound relations.
The repository index must expose the Potatoism corpus and its sublayers.
The validation workflow must fail on malformed JSON, duplicate IDs and unresolved canonical endpoints.
implementation_note: Declarative routing contract shared by browser loaders, graph tooling and validators.
